summary: v2.26 tested end-to-end (backend + web). Backend (pytest 6/6 pass): (1) POST /api/crm/leads/{id}/enrich-company and POST /api/crm/leads/{id}/enrich now return HTTP 200 with matched:false on provider failure — no more Cloudflare 502; (2) POST /api/crm/leads/{id}/ai-enrich extracts contact + notes from the Prem Soman PDF via file_url (email=somanp@upmc.edu, npi=1265407225, 30+ notes, source_chars ~5k); (3) ai-enrich/accept applies chosen fields into lead.enrichment, mirrors onto top-level, and prepends an 'AI update:' note; (4) validation with no file/text/url on empty lead returns 400 (not 5xx); (5) text-only enrichment works. Web frontend: fixed a compile-blocking duplicate `ai` useState declaration in LeadDetail.js that was preventing the entire lead-detail page from rendering; then ran the full flow as account_manager — Enrich Practice returned no 502, AI Enrich modal opened, extracted 12 contact fields from pasted research text in ~4s, Apply persisted the fields (Data Completeness 33% → 56%) and 'AI update:' note was prepended to Notes.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate `const [ai, setAi] = useState(...)` declarations (lines 29 and 34) caused a SyntaxError — the ENTIRE /crm/leads/{id} page failed to compile with 'Identifier ai has already been declared'. Any user opening a lead detail saw a red Webpack error overlay instead of the page. Fixed by merging the two useState objects into one on line 29. Reference: /app/frontend/src/pages/crm/LeadDetail.js:29-34

action_items: Review merged `ai` state in LeadDetail.js (line 29) — I combined the pre-existing { busy, prep, brief } with the new AI Enrich fields { open, text, file, result, pick }; note that `ai.busy` is now SHARED across AI Draft Email, AI Prep Call, AI Draft Text, Research Brief and AI Enrich flows — so running one will disable/gray-out the others until it completes. If independence is needed, split into separate state slices (e.g., `aiEnrich` / `aiPrep`).
Consider making the compile-time duplicate identifier issue impossible by wiring `eslint --max-warnings=0` (or `no-redeclare`) into CI so future merges can't ship a broken LeadDetail again.
critical_code_review_comments: LeadDetail.js is 628 lines and mixes many concerns (email/call/text/research/enrich/AI-enrich/edit modals + status + assign). Consider extracting modals into per-file components.

In /api/crm/leads/{id}/ai-enrich (routes_ai_enrich.py:54) the outer try still raises HTTPException(502) on LLM failure — this is fine because it is our controlled error, but if you want ZERO 5xx surface (matching the enrich-company hardening) you could return 200 {job_id:null, error:...}. Current behavior is acceptable and returns detail, not a gateway HTML page.

routes_ai_enrich._TOP maps work_email → email but the accept loop applies fields in list order; if the user picks both `email` (null) and `work_email` in some cases, top-level email may still be filled correctly, but order is not deterministic — consider preferring work_email over email explicitly.

After UI apply-flow it holds an 'AI update' note + enrichment fields for Dr. Prem Soman. Status moved to Disqualified to hide from active queues. DELETE /api/crm/leads/{id} is Method Not Allowed so hard-delete wasn't possible; main agent can remove it via the DB or Admin console if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v2.26 flows verified. If main agent adjusts the merged `ai` state in LeadDetail.js, re-run: (1) open a lead as account_manager → click 'AI Enrich' → paste text → Run → Apply — verify the toast, notes list gets an 'AI update' note, and Data Completeness increases; (2) click 'Enrich Practice' → verify friendly no-match copy (no 502). Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration23_ai_enrich.py.
rca of the issue: The v2.26 feature added a new `[ai, setAi] = useState({ open, text, file, busy, result, pick })` at LeadDetail.js:34 without noticing an existing `[ai, setAi] = useState({ busy, prep, brief })` at line 29 used by AI Draft Email, AI Prep Call, AI Draft Text and Research Brief. Babel raised 'Identifier ai has already been declared' → LeadDetail.js failed to compile → the whole lead-detail page rendered a red Webpack overlay in preview. Reproduction: (before fix) navigate to /crm/leads/{any-id} — the page never mounts. Mitigation applied: merged both objects into a single useState on line 29 so all existing usages continue to work and the AI Enrich modal now reads/writes ai.open/text/file/result/pick on the same slice. Follow-up recommended: split into two state slices if you need independent `busy` flags per AI feature.
